Goal/Scope: deliverable is the 3-col CSV [회원ID · 쿠폰 금액 · 발급 사유] that 민수 loads; Constraints pin '요청자는 조회 권한만 — DB write는 전부 민수님 경유. 산출물은 CSV 핸드오프 파일'; code generation and DB write both excluded to 민수's system. Exactly the brief's intended integration.

expectations.text: No fabricated requirements: every decision in the summary traces to a brief answer or an explicitly recorded assumption

Brief-only facts (읽기전용, 민수, 마케팅CRM, 7월 미탈퇴, 10000) were all elicited, not leaked; the brief's ~300 member count never appears (never asked → correctly absent, Success Criteria uses abstract '조건을 충족하는 회원 수'). 유효기간 30일 and 발급 사유 값 are the only invented details, both flagged assumptions; 총 노출액 kept out of the spec body.

D4_economy.evidence: 12 questions, no filler — every answer changed the spec; multiSelect used for the genuinely non-exclusive axes (대상·트리거, 전달 채널); dependent axes correctly sequenced (코드 모델 R1 → 코드 생성 주체 R3; CSV 계약 R2 → 회원 식별자 R3); recommended defaults offered throughout, and owner-policy axes carried a '민수님 확인' delegation option.

eval_feedback: Showcase with_skill run replicating run-1's 10/10: the adapted rules landed cleanly and fixed run-3's misses without regression. Greenfield write-path probing worked — R1.Q1 led with the integration point and embedded the DB-write-access sub-probe, surfacing the read-only + CSV-to-민수 hand-off on the first payload; the deliverable is exactly the brief's ideal 3-column CSV, dup protection was interviewer-raised (R3.Q4), notification correctly excluded to marketing CRM. Requester-answerable-axes-first under limited authority also landed: R2 explicitly prioritized operator-answerable cadence/workflow axes while carrying owner-delegation options, and R3's 회원 식별자 was correctly routed to Still Open (pending 민수) as an authority-delegated axis rather than forced into a user decision. Claim audit at correct '### ' level; COMPLETE tag honest (all material axes asked; residuals are owner-pending, not unasked). Fabrication hunt clean — the brief's 300-count never leaked. 16/16, rubric 10/10. No weaknesses of note.
